headline: MIN @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 5.09 at CHW 3.81, with a projected total of 8.89. Batter research is strongest for Munetaka Murakami, Miguel Vargas, Brooks Lee, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Victor Caratini because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
